d: Two corporate holiday party crashers find themselves in over their heads when they're invited into an influential family's home to plan their Christmas Eve bash.
BET+ ORIGINAL. After a disastrous Thanksgiving dinner, a holiday-obsessed travel writer decides to take an assignment that will keep her away from her family and boyfriend during Christmas.
A globe-trotting influencer returns home for Christmas and reconnects with her childhood sweetheart as they team up to save their beloved roller rink from foreclosure.

Gerald Davenport has requested his three estranged daughters Diedre, Nicole, and Tammy come together for Christmas for a big announcement…he has won a $10-million-dollar lottery! To get their share, the sisters must repair their broken relationship.
After an on-and-off relationship, Noelle and Terrance reunite during the holidays, but Noelle is surprised when Terrance returns home with a new girlfriend of the same name.
Two co-workers agree to a loveless marriage of convenience, but as they become acquainted, an unrealized chemistry grows between them.
After the loss of her mother, a woman is visited by her father's spirit to keep the holiday spirit alive.
